wall_notes: No server-side aggregation; run hours derived by integrating each point's binary status History. Main obstacle response size: ~672 rows/point/week, so ~10-13 fav_ids/batch exceeded the token cap and the gateway spilled to local files - turned into an advantage by computing with local Python reading the saved files (no raw rows in context). Hard limit is breadth: ~395 status points (many not run-hours signals - filter/lockout/VAV/poll). Scoped to 35 major channels and reported coverage. NB: this replicate did NOT discover the over-capture trap as cleanly as needed - still found points via metadata_name LIKE and had to judgement-exclude non-run-status classes.
